ActOf.description:
``person`` did their historical act. Met when no human plays them (history
follows the record); else only when an order that human filed has got there.
ActOf.title: ActOf

AgentSet.description:
A nation's agent placed (``index`` one past its last) or lost (IOR). Engine only:
it says where the nation has an agent; the holder of an area where one is lost learns
of it from its paper.
AgentSet.title: AgentSet

Agreement.description: An agreement in force: every named nation accepted the same version.
Agreement.title: Agreement

AgreementClause.description:
One clause of an agreement (AGR rule 1): the party it binds, what it binds them to,
and its date, or None for a standing clause.
AgreementClause.title: AgreementClause

AgreementInForce.description:
An agreement is in force among nations that include every one ``between``
names, none of its clauses broken (AGR).
AgreementInForce.title: AgreementInForce

AgreementMade.description:
An agreement in force, in full (AGR): every named nation accepted the same version
of an offer, or a world or a conference made it. Sealed to the seats of its parties'
nations.
AgreementMade.title: AgreementMade

AgreementOffer.description: An offer of an agreement, as its parties know it.
AgreementOffer.title: AgreementOffer

AgreementOffered.description:
An offer of an agreement filed, as its parties know it (AGR). Sealed to the seats of
its parties' nations.
AgreementOffered.title: AgreementOffered

AgreementPublished.description: A party published an agreement by order (AGR). Public.
AgreementPublished.title: AgreementPublished

AidFinding.description:
An aid finding as the board holds it (PRL): the form, the figure it draws on, and
each recipient's share figure and eligibility flag, by polity.
AidFinding.title: AidFinding

AimRule.description:
What makes a card's aim a goal (AIM): its condition, in plain words, over the
period it is judged in. ``sees`` holds one exposure per leaf, in ``leaves`` order,
set by the compiler from the world. Engine only, on the card.
AimRule.title: AimRule

Allocate.description: Money or materiel to a recipient.
Allocate.title: Allocate

Answer.description: One thing a person does back, with when, how soon and how often.
Answer.title: Answer

AnswerAct.description:
What the person does: one of their own forms, or a typed effect inside their
authority.
AnswerAct.title: AnswerAct

AnswerMade.description:
The answer fell due: the order it filed, the approach it put to a player, or why
there was neither. Engine only.
AnswerMade.title: AnswerMade

AnswerPlanned.description: A person nobody plays took up one of their answers, to act on ``due``. Engine only.
AnswerPlanned.title: AnswerPlanned

AnswerWhen.description:
What sets an answer off: a form filed through to the end (``lever``), a typed
act that landed (``effect``), or a date on a cadence (``every_days``).
AnswerWhen.title: AnswerWhen

AreaHeld.description:
A territory changed hands (THL): its new holder, the one it was taken from, and the
day. Public: holders are public.
AreaHeld.title: AreaHeld

Ask.description:
One part of an order before it is routed: what the seat wants, in short words,
and the typed effect where the reader found one.
Ask.title: Ask

Asked.description:
A held order asked for, once, by its own seat (ASK): who asked, the person the ask
went to and the seat that holds that person, if any, and the order's plain words. It
decides nothing and opens nothing. The person asked learns only this.
Asked.title: Asked

AtWar.description: Nations ``a`` and ``b`` are at war (``war`` true) or not (false). Public.
AtWar.title: AtWar

Base.description: A site a side's pieces work from, for the domains it names (``base`` in the world).
Base.title: Base

Battle.description: A battle open in an area. Engine only.
Battle.title: Battle

BattleDecided.description:
A side's decision for a battle, or pieces that joined it (BDC). With ``decision``,
the side's decision in force from ``on``, given in wake ``wake``; with ``joined``, the
pieces that stepped in and joined the side, bringing ``added`` strength. Engine only:
a seat's own order is fed to it already, and a join carries the true strength.
BattleDecided.title: BattleDecided

BattleEnded.description:
A battle ended (BTL): how, and the nation left with the field. Engine only; the
news item beside it is public.
BattleEnded.title: BattleEnded

BattleOpened.description:
A battle opened in an area (BTL): its two sides, the pieces and the strength each
brought. Engine only: it carries both sides' true strengths.
BattleOpened.title: BattleOpened

BattleRound.description:
One day's round of a battle (BTL): each side's score and draw, attacker first, and
the steps each lost. Engine only. The ``feature_set`` beside it sets the pieces.
BattleRound.title: BattleRound

BattleSide.description:
One side of a battle: its leading nation, the pieces it brought (in id order), the
strength they brought and the steps they have lost; the decision in force and the wake
it was given (BDC).
BattleSide.title: BattleSide

Bias.description: The transform the author's bias applied, in percent [proposed].
Bias.title: Bias

BlocVote.description: A bloc's part of one chamber vote: its members voting and the yeas among them.
BlocVote.title: BlocVote

BodyField.description: One structured line of a document: what the author claims, never the truth.
BodyField.title: BodyField

Call.description: An attack that calls on a defence clause: war on ``against`` is due by ``due``.
Call.title: Call

Capture.description:
A territory's capture count and capital mark. Engine only.

``by`` and ``since``: the polity whose land pieces have stood there unopposed, and the
first day they did; None while nobody counts. ``marked``: the tick of the wake in which
a capital's territory was marked as falling, and ``marked_on`` its day; None unmarked.
Capture.title: Capture

CaptureCounted.description:
A territory's capture count or capital mark as it stands at the end of a day in the
walk (THL); None when it has neither. Engine only: it says where pieces stand.
CaptureCounted.title: CaptureCounted

CardAmended.description:
A game takes the world file's word on who a person stands with and against, how
they answer, how they write and how they are addressed, replacing what its card held.
Engine only: these are AI policy. ``voice`` or ``addressed_as`` None leaves the card's
value as it was.
CardAmended.title: CardAmended

CardPath.description: Which ladder the office stands on (CMD). Read with the ``command`` rule on.
CardPath.title: CardPath

CardsDeclared.description:
The scenario's cards, feeds and pipelines, compiled from the world file.

One event, after the entities it names, so the fold can check every
reference at once. Engine only: cards carry the AI policy fields.
CardsDeclared.title: CardsDeclared

Cause.description: Why support moved: a happening, writing, or the Monday drift.
Cause.title: Cause

ChannelKind.description: How words travel. Each trades speed against exposure (direction, channels table).
ChannelKind.title: ChannelKind

Character.description:
A real person from the chosen moment that a player may claim (spec §5 step 3).

Judged by agency in history, not fame. Where the record names no one, the
character is a composite: named, built from what people in that role did,
and labelled as such in the brief.
Character.title: Character

CharacterClaimed.description:
A player takes a character from the roster (spec §5 step 3).

The fold creates the player's seat here, embodying the character. The
engine gives this event an ID derived from the campaign and the character,
so a second claim of the same person fails at the store, not just here.
CharacterClaimed.title: CharacterClaimed

CharacterListed.description: One character on the Session Zero roster. Public: every player sees the roster.
CharacterListed.title: CharacterListed

CharacterReleased.description:
A player gives up the character they claimed, before the game begins.

Realism games only. The fold removes the player's seat and frees the
character, so it can be claimed again. The engine derives this event's ID
from the character and how many releases it has had, and each later claim's
ID from the same count, so two players racing for a freed person still
cannot both land.
CharacterReleased.title: CharacterReleased

CharacterSide.description: Where a roster character stands in one contest. Public, like the roster.
CharacterSide.title: CharacterSide

ClauseJudged.description:
A clause of an agreement judged on ``on`` from the state (AGR): kept, broken, or
called on by an attack on ``against`` with war due by ``due``. With ``against`` and
``kept``, the call on that attacker is answered. Sealed to the parties' seats until the
agreement is published.
ClauseJudged.title: ClauseJudged

ClauseType.description: The clauses the rules can check (AGR rule 2), and the one they cannot.
ClauseType.title: ClauseType

ClockStatusSet.description: Fail or abandon a clock. Resolution happens by filling it (``ClockAdvance``).
ClockStatusSet.title: ClockStatusSet

CodebreakingSet.description: A nation's codebreaking level raised by one, from ``on`` (IOR). Engine only.
CodebreakingSet.title: CodebreakingSet

Commitment.description: A treaty, contract or deal. Promises in chat are not Commitments.
Commitment.title: Commitment

Conference.title: Conference

ConferenceCalled.description:
A conference called by a seat, or a world's conference scheduled (at compile,
sealed to no seat) and opened on its day (CNF). Sealed to the invited nations' seats,
or public when the conference is.
ConferenceCalled.title: ConferenceCalled

ConferenceTallied.description:
A conference's tally on its voting day: each invited nation's counted vote and the
outcome (CNF). Scoped as its call. Never says how a seat was run.
ConferenceTallied.title: ConferenceTallied

ConferenceText.description:
What a conference votes on: its wording, its clauses, the topics its words touch
(by key, worked out when it is called) and whether only a unanimous vote passes it.
ConferenceText.title: ConferenceText

Conflict.description: Something the person is set against, as the world file declares it.
Conflict.title: Conflict

Contact.description: A person in the inner circle, and how the words travel.
Contact.title: Contact

Contest.description:
A pressure that keeps the world moving (spec §5.3).

A rivalry's track runs -100..100, positive favouring ``sides[0]``. A trial's
runs 0..100, 100 = passed. ``momentum`` moves the track every turn whether or
not anyone acts. ``countdown_days`` is in-world days to the deciding point.
Contest.title: Contest

ContestDecided.description:
The countdown reached zero; the track decided it. ``winner`` None is a draw
or a failed trial. The world keeps running.
ContestDecided.title: ContestDecided

ContestMove.description:
One move a contest names (CON). It lands once: ``landed`` from the day it did.

``region`` (a region key, its subregions included) for a battle; ``area`` for a
holder; ``quantity`` for a flag; for a line, exactly one of ``quantity``, ``nation``
alone (its war-economy figure) or ``nation`` with ``group`` (the group's support),
crossed upward to at or above ``line``, or with ``falling`` downward to below it;
``between`` (two or more nations) for an agreement.
ContestMove.title: ContestMove

ContestMoved.description:
A contest's track moved, by momentum, by a resolved order, or by one of its own
moves landing (CON: ``move``, the move's index, once), and its countdown ran down by
the in-world days the tick covered (none for a move).
ContestMoved.title: ContestMoved

ContestWon.description: A contest has been decided for ``side`` (CON).
ContestWon.title: ContestWon

Contingency.description: A force's standing order for a battle, set through the engagement effect (BDC).
Contingency.title: Contingency

ContingencyKind.description: What a force does in a battle with no decision from its seat (BDC).
ContingencyKind.title: ContingencyKind

CostLogged.description:
Model calls made outside a tick (structuring an order, a briefing, a deputy turn).

Tick costs live on ``tick_closed``; everything else lands here so ``revisionist cost``
can account for every call. A record kind: it changes no state.
CostLogged.title: CostLogged

CounselHeld.description:
A seat consulted a person on its card. The words are prose and change nothing;
a record, sealed with the seat's key like an order's text.
CounselHeld.title: CounselHeld

DateAdvanced.description: The calendar moved today's in-world date (spec §5.7).
DateAdvanced.title: DateAdvanced

Deal.description: Offer a deal, or accept one.
Deal.title: Deal

Decider.description:
Who can allow a held order: a person, or a nation's chamber or chambers, with the
head of that nation's government, to whom an ask goes (ASK).
Decider.title: Decider

Decision.description: A side's decision for its battle (BDC). Reinforce is a move order, not stored.
Decision.title: Decision

DirectiveGiven.description:
A seat signed a directive: its own words to a contact, and the order the aide
read them as, filed in the same batch. A record, sealed with the seat's key.
DirectiveGiven.title: DirectiveGiven

Disclosure.description: Reveal a fact to the public, or conceal it.
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

DocumentFlagged.description: A seat flagged a document, or took the flag off. A record; the latest event wins.
DocumentFlagged.title: DocumentFlagged

DocumentIssued.description: A document is written. Its envelope scope is the view's; seats see it on arrival.
DocumentIssued.title: DocumentIssued

DocumentRead.description: A seat opened a document (the in-tray's unread mark). A record.
DocumentRead.title: DocumentRead

DocumentTruth.description: Engine only. Never in a ``View``, a snapshot or a prompt.
DocumentTruth.title: DocumentTruth

DocumentView.description: The page a seat reads. Visible once in scope and ``arrives`` has come.
DocumentView.title: DocumentView

DocumentWritten.description:
The prose model wrote a document's page from its view and its author's voice.

Scoped like the document. Folded into the view; a document is written at most
once, so a resumed tick cannot write it twice.
DocumentWritten.title: DocumentWritten

EconomySet.description:
A nation's pools after the first-of-the-month payment (YLD). Sealed to the nation's
seats: true figures.
EconomySet.title: EconomySet

EffectsApplied.description:
A part's effects landed in the world (spec §8.2-8.3): an executed command, an
estimate, or a decided influence. A refusal applies nothing but still closes the
part. ``revealed`` facts become public. Scoped to the issuer.
EffectsApplied.title: EffectsApplied

EffectsEstimated.description:
The estimator's ruling on one part no code rule covers (spec §8.3).

The effects are engine-only; ``reason`` is the issuer's, written from its view
and leak-scanned. ``rationale`` is sealed for the end-of-game reveal. A replay
reads this event and never calls the model. ``failed``: the model gave nothing
usable, the part stays unresolved, and the paper says so.
EffectsEstimated.title: EffectsEstimated

Expect.description:
One move the seat's staff expect an option to make. Staff talk, not a forecast:
no rule reads it, and filing the option is the same with or without it.
Expect.title: Expect

ExpectOn.description: What an expected move points at. Each is something the seat's view holds.
ExpectOn.title: ExpectOn

Exposure.description: Whether the seat may see the fact a leaf of its aim reads (AIM rule 5).
Exposure.title: Exposure

Fact.description: A structured truth with an ACL. Never prose.
Fact.title: Fact

FeatureSet.description:
A force, front or route as it stands: authored at compile, moved by the
movement resolver after. Engine only, like a quantity.
FeatureSet.title: FeatureSet

Feed.description: A source of documents on a cadence (pillar 3). Whose desk it reaches is on the cards.
Feed.title: Feed

Fidelity.description: How an executor carried out a command (spec §8.2).
Fidelity.title: Fidelity

Forecast.description:
What the staff expected a picked suggestion to move and what they thought it
risked, kept with the order it filed (FCS). Private to the issuer, as the order is.
No rule reads it: an order files and lands the same with or without it.
Forecast.title: Forecast

Goal.description:
One player seat's secret goal. Private to its owner (decision 37).

A goal made from a card's aim (AIM) is keyed to the person whose aim it is
(``person``, ``source``, ``aim``): it is reached through the seat holding that
person at the time, has no objective clock, and ``seat_id`` names the seat it was
made for. A legacy goal has none of the three and keeps its seat and clock.
Goal.title: Goal

GoalApproved.description:
The host let a goal the balance check flagged stand. The host sees the scores
and the flag, never the goal. A record.
GoalApproved.title: GoalApproved

GoalMet.description: The goal's condition holds at the end of this tick, first time or again.
GoalMet.title: GoalMet

GoalProgressed.description: The goal's objective clock moved: ``parts_met`` of its parts hold now.
GoalProgressed.title: GoalProgressed

GoalProposed.description:
The goals a player's agent offered on one route (spec §5 step 4). A record,
Private to the seat and sealed with its key: these are the player's own words.
GoalProposed.title: GoalProposed

GoalSet.description: A seat's secret goal, fixed at Session Zero (spec §15). Private to the owner.
GoalSet.title: GoalSet

GoalSource.description: Where a goal made from an aim comes from (AIM).
GoalSource.title: GoalSource

GoalUndone.description: An Undoable goal stopped holding. It counts as unmet until it holds again.
GoalUndone.title: GoalUndone

Group.description: A group at home as the world declares it. True: a view holds its own nation's.
Group.title: Group

GroupMoved.description:
A nation's group's support moved (GRP): to ``support``, by ``change`` after the
clamp to 0 to 100, for ``cause``, on world day ``on``. ``used``: the writing points
the day's batch spent toward the week cap (absolute, never restored); 0 for any other
cause. Sealed to the nation's seats: true support.
GroupMoved.title: GroupMoved

GroupNudge.description:
Writing that moves a nation's group at home by ``change`` points (FWG). Only the
estimator returns it, or a theme the world lists: a seat never orders one. The issuer's
own nation's group, or another nation's that the world marks as hearing abroad.
GroupNudge.title: GroupNudge

GroupProposed.description:
Writing by a seat proposing to move a group, waiting for its day's batch (GRP).
Engine only: the batch, not the filing, decides what moves.
GroupProposed.title: GroupProposed

GroupsDeclared.description:
Each nation's groups at home as the world declares them (GRP), by nation, in the
world file's order. Engine only: a seat reads its own nation's groups from its own
data; once, at creation.
GroupsDeclared.title: GroupsDeclared

Happening.description: The fixed list of happenings a group may be moved by (rule 3).
Happening.title: Happening

HeldChoice.description:
What the holder of a step on another seat's order chose there. Kept for the
holder alone until the step's held due day, when the runner takes the step with it
in the card's place.
HeldChoice.title: HeldChoice

HeldOrder.description:
An order a lock holds: a form order as drafted, or a written order's asks, with
the row that holds it (none for a derived decider), its decider, and the reason its
seat was told. No clock ends it.
HeldOrder.title: HeldOrder

HeldOrderEnded.description:
A held order ends (LCK): replaced by a later order from its seat to the same force
and zone, landed, failed its re-check, or withdrawn. Sealed to the issuer's seat.
HeldOrderEnded.title: HeldOrderEnded

HoldsArea.description: A territory's holder now is ``holder`` (THL). Public.
HoldsArea.title: HoldsArea

IncomeAt.description: A nation's war-economy figure (YLD), 0 to 100, against a line. Public.
IncomeAt.title: IncomeAt

InfluenceDecided.description:
The person an influence part was aimed at decided, under their card's policy
(spec §8.2). ``reason`` is read by the issuer and leak-scanned. Scoped to the issuer.
InfluenceDecided.title: InfluenceDecided

Informant.description:
The person who reports one source for a nation, the channel, and the source's rank
(its place in the world's list, from 1, the first highest). Contact no one is named
for reports with rank 0, above every listed source.
Informant.title: Informant

IntelOrder.description:
The intelligence orders an existing effect kind carries (IOR). A patrol is the
patrol posture and a concealment the engagement's ``concealed``; neither is here.
IntelOrder.title: IntelOrder

Intelligence.description: A nation's sources as declared at the start.
Intelligence.title: Intelligence

IntelligenceDeclared.description:
Each nation's sources as the world declares them (DET): who reports each source and
by what channel, the codebreaking level, and the agents by area. Engine only; once, at
creation.
IntelligenceDeclared.title: IntelligenceDeclared

KindsDeclared.description:
The world's own piece kinds and resources, in the world file's order. Public; once,
at creation, before any feature is set.
KindsDeclared.title: KindsDeclared

KnowledgeGrant.description:
Widen who knows an existing fact, asset or clock.

Discovery, leaks, exposure rolls and ``reveal()`` all emit this. Nothing
else in the engine knows about reveals.
KnowledgeGrant.title: KnowledgeGrant

LawNotInForce.description: Holds while no passed law carrying ``clause`` is in force for the issuer's nation.
LawNotInForce.title: LawNotInForce

Leg.description: One move the record says a feature made.
Leg.title: Leg

Lever.description: Something the person can set moving. Names a pipeline and a resolver, never a verb.
Lever.title: Lever

LiftPriority.description: The production priority's form and the choice of it that grows a lift pool (PRL).
LiftPriority.title: LiftPriority

Link.description:
Two areas that border, ``a`` before ``b``; ``crossing`` names a link across
water or a strait where they share no border.
Link.title: Link

LockRow.description:
One row of the world's ``locks``: which order, under which condition, needs
which decision, from whom.
LockRow.title: LockRow

LocksDeclared.description:
The world's locks (DCD): which order, under which condition, needs which decision,
from whom, in the world file's order. World data; once, at creation, with ``locks``
on.
LocksDeclared.title: LocksDeclared

MandateIssued.description: A mandate lands on a seat's agenda (spec §8.5). Scoped to the seat.
MandateIssued.title: MandateIssued

MandateTemplate.description:
A mandate before it is issued: code fills it in when its trigger fires, one
mandate per seat embodying a person in ``to`` (spec §8.5). Engine only.
MandateTemplate.title: MandateTemplate

MapDeclared.description:
The board the world file defines: areas, regions, terrain and adjacency, with
the map file's name and hash, never its shapes. Public; once, at creation.
MapDeclared.title: MapDeclared

MoveFigure.description:
A figure no resolver computes, moved by a percent of its value. Only the
estimator returns it: a seat never orders one.
MoveFigure.title: MoveFigure

MoveForce.description: Move a force, posture it, or both.
MoveForce.title: MoveForce

MoveKind.description: What moves a contest (CON): each a step toward one of its sides.
MoveKind.title: MoveKind

NarrationWritten.description: Prose for exactly one seat, written from that seat's view.
NarrationWritten.title: NarrationWritten

NationGroups.description: One nation's groups at home, in the world file's order, and its themes.
NationGroups.title: NationGroups

NationVote.description: One invited nation's counted vote at the tally.
NationVote.title: NationVote

NewsEvent.description:
A public event, as structured public facts only. Never prose. One per event;
each seat's press later words it in its own outlet's voice.
NewsEvent.title: NewsEvent

NewsReported.description: A public event, as structured facts. Each seat's press words it later.
NewsReported.title: NewsReported

Offer.description: What a seat is offered for one agenda item.
Offer.title: Offer

OpponentsRanked.description: The people actively opposing a seat, as the truth has it. Engine only.
OpponentsRanked.title: OpponentsRanked

Option.description:
A guided step or a beginner option: an ordinary order and what it risks,
as the seat understands it.
Option.title: Option

OptionsOffered.description: What the option generator offered a seat this wake. A record, sealed to the seat.
OptionsOffered.title: OptionsOffered

OrderAsked.description:
A seat asks, once, for its held order (ASK): one paper before the seat holding the
person who decides it, or the card when no seat does. Sealed to the asker and that
seat. It decides nothing and opens nothing.
OrderAsked.title: OrderAsked

OrderDrafted.description: A seat pulled a lever: the order enters its pipeline at step 0.
OrderDrafted.title: OrderDrafted

OrderExecuted.description:
An executor carried out a command part, with a fidelity, or refused it under
a stated rule (spec §8.2). Scoped to the issuer.
OrderExecuted.title: OrderExecuted

OrderHeld.title: OrderHeld

OrderMatch.description:
Which order a row holds: a form with some of its parameter values, or an effect
kind with a zone or a force.
OrderMatch.title: OrderMatch

OrderReceived.description: Raw player text. Always Private to the seat. Encrypted at rest from Layer 9.
OrderReceived.title: OrderReceived

OrderRouted.description:
A committed order, split into parts and each part routed (spec §8.2).

Scoped to the issuer. A replay reads the routes from here; it never routes again.
OrderRouted.title: OrderRouted

OrderSettled.description: The order left its pipeline: enacted, refused, lapsed or withdrawn.
OrderSettled.title: OrderSettled

OrderStepTaken.description: The person at the order's current step acted on it.
OrderStepTaken.title: OrderStepTaken

Ordered.description:
A seat embodying ``person`` issued a routed order with a part of this effect
kind (given, or estimated) whose effects have landed. Never met while no human
holds ``person``: a mandate is the seat's own work (engine v2, spec §8.5).
Ordered.title: Ordered

Outlet.description: A seat's newspaper: the voice its press is written in.
Outlet.title: Outlet

ParamSpec.description: One typed parameter of a lever. An order's params and every amendment must fit it.
ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec

PartRef.description: One part of one routed order: what a pipeline order carries (wave B).
PartRef.title: PartRef

Persona.description: The player-designed face of their agent. Narrative only; no mechanics.
Persona.title: Persona

PieceKind.description: One kind of piece the world names.
PieceKind.title: PieceKind

PieceStepped.description:
A piece entered an area: one step, by order, by the record, or forced. Sealed to the
seats of the piece's own nation, who know it by its mark (``territory.mark_key``), not
its id. A record: the ``feature_set`` beside it moves the piece.
PieceStepped.title: PieceStepped

PlayStyleSet.description: A seat's play style (spec §8.6). Sealed to the seat; shown at the reveal.
PlayStyleSet.title: PlayStyleSet

Pools.description: A nation's pools, filled on the first of each month.
Pools.title: Pools

Port.description:
A place where a territory meets a sea zone: a sea piece declared there stands in
the zone, and a land piece embarks or lands there on a lift.
Port.title: Port

PostureNotSet.description:
Holds while no superior of the issuer has set the named posture for the zone.

Two namings, at least one given. The written path: the latest engagement a superior
landed whose zone names ``zone`` carries ``rule``. The form path: the latest enacted
order of ``form`` a superior issued whose parameters carry ``where`` (the zone, as the
form names it) also carries ``posture``.
PostureNotSet.title: PostureNotSet

Production.description:
What the production rules read from the world (PRL). Absent from a board compiled
before it: such a stored game keeps the rules' own names.
Production.title: Production

Proposal.description:
One seat's writing proposing to move a group (rule 2). Engine only: it carries a
hash of the text, never the text, and no filing time.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposeMeasure.description: A bill, treaty or declaration, as a set of clauses.
ProposeMeasure.title: ProposeMeasure

QuantitySet.description: A quantity's value as of a date: authored at compile, computed by a resolver after.
QuantitySet.title: QuantitySet

Reach.description:
What reach is derived from (spec §8.1). Whether a meeting is taken is computed
in code from rank, disposition and standing; nothing here is a whitelist.
Reach.title: Reach

RegardAt.description:
How ``a`` and ``b`` regard each other (a relationship's disposition, -5 to 5)
against a line; 0 when they have no relationship yet.
RegardAt.title: RegardAt

Report.description: What a nation believes about one enemy piece, from one source on one day.
Report.title: Report

ReportMade.description:
A nation's source reported an enemy piece (DET). Engine only: it names the true
piece and records whether the report is wrong (``shift``); a seat gets the report in
its view once it arrives, and as a line of its source's page.
ReportMade.title: ReportMade

RequestAnswered.description:
The holder of a person another seat asked something of gives their answer (ANS).
The fold keeps it on the part, engine side, and the request's due-day pass decides
with it in the card's place, so the issuer learns nothing before that day and the
decision reads the same as the card's. Given again, the later answer stands. Scoped
to the holder.
RequestAnswered.title: RequestAnswered

Risks.description: How much the staff think an option risks, each from 0 (none) to 3. No rule reads it.
Risks.title: Risks

Role.description: What a resource is for. Several resources may share a role; a role may have none.
Role.title: Role

RoutedOrder.description: A committed order, split into routed parts (spec §8.2).
RoutedOrder.title: RoutedOrder

RoutedPart.description: The whole part. ``estimated`` never leaves the engine.
RoutedPart.title: RoutedPart

Rule.description:
A rule of the territory game a world switches on by name. A stored game, and a
world that names none, has none on; every such rule checks its name before it acts.
Rule.title: Rule

ScheduledEvent.description:
Something due to happen. Play events fire at a tick; history events fire on
an in-world date if their condition still holds, and are skipped otherwise.
ScheduledEvent.title: ScheduledEvent

ScheduledEventCreated.description: An item on history's clock, written by the world draft.
ScheduledEventCreated.title: ScheduledEventCreated

ScheduledEventSkipped.description: A history event came due but its condition no longer held.
ScheduledEventSkipped.title: ScheduledEventSkipped

Sealed.description:
What a sealed event looks like at rest (Layer 9b): the real event, whole,
is encrypted into the envelope's ``payload_enc``.

The store unseals on read, so the tick, the fold and every reader see the
plaintext event. A ``seat``-held event whose key was destroyed (erasure)
stays sealed: it is prose the fold never needed. A ``campaign``-held one
that reaches the fold is an error: its key is missing.
Sealed.title: Sealed

SeasonEnded.description:
The season is over and its winners decided (spec §15, decision 36).

Logged right after the full reveal's grants, ``revealed`` of them, and it
makes every goal public. ``winners`` is whatever ``season_winners`` says;
the fold checks it, so a log cannot crown anyone the engine did not.
SeasonEnded.title: SeasonEnded

Seat.description:
Anything that holds a view of the world (spec §6, §7, §10).

Humans, AI factions, press outlets and NPCs are all Seats, because they
all need ``project(state, seat_id)``. Only ``PLAYER`` seats hold slots
and an agent persona.
Seat.title: Seat

SeatCard.description:
The whole card. The policy fields below are how code runs an unclaimed person;
they never leave the engine.
SeatCard.title: SeatCard

SeatHandover.description:
A leader changes hands at the next wake boundary: ``HUMAN`` when a new player
takes up a leader nobody plays, ``AI`` when the leader's player leaves. The fold holds
the change in ``State.handovers`` and applies it when the open wake closes. Sealed to
the seat that changes hands: how a seat is run is never shown.
SeatHandover.title: SeatHandover

SessionZeroClosed.description: Every player has a character, a goal and an agent: play begins.
SessionZeroClosed.title: SessionZeroClosed

SessionZeroOpened.description:
The table locked a point in history with ``/establish`` (spec §5 step 2).

Ticks wait until Session Zero closes. ``notes`` is where the GM logs each
reading it chose where historians disagree or the record is silent.
SessionZeroOpened.title: SessionZeroOpened

Shift.description: How a wrong report is wrong. Engine only: never in a report or a view.
Shift.title: Shift

ShiftDisposition.description: How ``of`` regards ``toward``. Feeds resolvers; never sets a quantity.
ShiftDisposition.title: ShiftDisposition

Sight.description: A document line's claim about a feature: what it is, whose, and where.
Sight.title: Sight

SightRef.description: The truth behind one sighting line.
SightRef.title: SightRef

Stance.description: Worst first, so the order of the members is the order of the stances.
Stance.title: Stance

StanceChanged.description:
A person nobody plays took a new stance toward a seat. Engine only: the seat
is shown the stance as its staff last had evidence for it.
StanceChanged.title: StanceChanged

Standing.description: One person's stance toward one seat, from the day it took hold.
Standing.title: Standing

StatementIssued.description:
A player's spin, made public as the tick freezes (Layer 9b).

Spin is the one free text a player addresses to the world (design §5), so
it is logged Public whatever the order's own scope: a covert operation can
come with a public denial. A record: it changes no state.
StatementIssued.title: StatementIssued

StepCause.description: What moved a piece one step.
StepCause.title: StepCause

StepChosen.description:
The holder of a decision step on another seat's order chooses what to do there.
The fold keeps it on the order, engine side, and on the step's held due day the
runner takes the step with it in the card's place, so the issuer learns nothing
before that day and the step reads the same as the card's. Chosen again, the later
choice stands. Scoped to the holder.
StepChosen.title: StepChosen

StepOutcome.description: What the person at one step did with the order.
StepOutcome.title: StepOutcome

StepRefused.description:
A piece's step was refused as it was to start, and the piece holds where it stands
(FUL: too little fuel). A record: the ``feature_set`` beside it halts the piece.
Sealed to the seats of the piece's own nation, who know it by its mark.
StepRefused.title: StepRefused

SupportAt.description: A group's support at home (GRP), 0 to 100, against a line.
SupportAt.title: SupportAt

Tally.description: A conference's result, on the day it was tallied.
Tally.title: Tally

Territory.description: A land area. Its ``area`` is the location entity standing for it.
Territory.title: Territory

Theme.description:
A theme a nation's writing may name, and the points it moves each of that nation's
groups by, signed (FWG rule 3).
Theme.title: Theme

Topic.description:
A matter people want or hold to, named by the world file. An order touches it
by its lever, the kind of a typed effect it carries, or one of its own words.
Engine only.
Topic.title: Topic

TradeLine.description: A trade line: ``amount`` of ``resource`` a month from ``exporter`` to ``importer``.
TradeLine.title: TradeLine

TradeSet.description:
A trade line as it stands from ``on`` (FUL): declared by the world, or opened or cut
by ``trade.set``. Sealed to the seats of the two nations it joins: true figures.
TradeSet.title: TradeSet

Trigger.description: When a mandate template issues (spec §8.5). Code reads it; no model does.
Trigger.title: Trigger

TruthRef.description: One truth a document was built from, and its value when issued.
TruthRef.title: TruthRef

Verb.description: Closed list. Adding one is a schema change with a migration note.
Verb.title: Verb

VoteSealed.description:
A seat's sealed vote in a conference, in the wake it was sealed in; a later one in
the same wake replaces it (CNF). Sealed to the voter: nobody else learns of it, not
even that it was filed, until the tally counts its nation.
VoteSealed.title: VoteSealed

WakeCommitted.description:
A seat sealed its orders for the wake. Public that it committed, never what.

The aide's commit for an absent seat is sealed to that seat: it names the orders
the aide filed, which no other seat may learn.
WakeCommitted.title: WakeCommitted

WakeOpened.description: A shared wake opens for the table (spec §4). Public.
WakeOpened.title: WakeOpened

WarDeclared.description: Two polities are at war. Public.
WarDeclared.title: WarDeclared

WarNeed.description:
What one choice of a form needs: its issuer's nation at war with ``nation``, a
polity's world key (WRL). A seat whose nation is not is told "<its nation> is not at war
with <nation>, " and then ``refusal``.
WarNeed.title: WarNeed

WorldMap.description: The board: everything about the map but its shapes.
WorldMap.title: WorldMap

YieldChanged.description:
Part of a territory's yield moved to another territory of the same holder (YLD).
Sealed to the holder's seats: true figures.
YieldChanged.title: YieldChanged

revisionist__core__realism__card__Domain.description: One field the office commands outright (spec §8.1).
revisionist__core__realism__card__Domain.title: Domain

revisionist__core__realism__effect__Clau.description: One clause of a measure. The votes resolver scores each bloc against each.
revisionist__core__realism__effect__Clau.title: Clause

revisionist__core__realism__kinds__Domai.description:
Where a piece moves: over land, over sea, through the air, or as an envoy, who
goes anywhere and fights nobody.
revisionist__core__realism__kinds__Domai.title: Domain

ActOf.description:
``person`` did their historical act. Met when no human plays them (history
follows the record); else only when an order that human filed has got there.
ActOf.title: ActOf

Agreement.description: An agreement in force: every named nation accepted the same version.
Agreement.title: Agreement

AgreementClause.description:
One clause of an agreement (AGR rule 1): the party it binds, what it binds them to,
and its date, or None for a standing clause.
AgreementClause.title: AgreementClause

AgreementInForce.description:
An agreement is in force among nations that include every one ``between``
names, none of its clauses broken (AGR).
AgreementInForce.title: AgreementInForce

AgreementOffer.description: An offer of an agreement, as its parties know it.
AgreementOffer.title: AgreementOffer

Agreements.description:
Offers and agreements (AGR). A view holds those its nation is a party to, and
every published agreement.
Agreements.title: Agreements

AidFinding.description:
An aid finding as the board holds it (PRL): the form, the figure it draws on, and
each recipient's share figure and eligibility flag, by polity.
AidFinding.title: AidFinding

AimRule.description:
What makes a card's aim a goal (AIM): its condition, in plain words, over the
period it is judged in. ``sees`` holds one exposure per leaf, in ``leaves`` order,
set by the compiler from the world. Engine only, on the card.
AimRule.title: AimRule

Allocate.description: Money or materiel to a recipient.
Allocate.title: Allocate

Answer.description: One thing a person does back, with when, how soon and how often.
Answer.title: Answer

AnswerAct.description:
What the person does: one of their own forms, or a typed effect inside their
authority.
AnswerAct.title: AnswerAct

AnswerLog.description: The last time a person took up one answer, and what came of it.
AnswerLog.title: AnswerLog

AnswerWhen.description:
What sets an answer off: a form filed through to the end (``lever``), a typed
act that landed (``effect``), or a date on a cadence (``every_days``).
AnswerWhen.title: AnswerWhen

Ask.description:
One part of an order before it is routed: what the seat wants, in short words,
and the typed effect where the reader found one.
Ask.title: Ask

Asked.description:
A held order asked for, once, by its own seat (ASK): who asked, the person the ask
went to and the seat that holds that person, if any, and the order's plain words. It
decides nothing and opens nothing. The person asked learns only this.
Asked.title: Asked

AtWar.description: Nations ``a`` and ``b`` are at war (``war`` true) or not (false). Public.
AtWar.title: AtWar

Ballot.description: A seat's sealed vote, and the wake it was sealed in.
Ballot.title: Ballot

Base.description: A site a side's pieces work from, for the domains it names (``base`` in the world).
Base.title: Base

Battle.description: A battle open in an area. Engine only.
Battle.title: Battle

BattleSide.description:
One side of a battle: its leading nation, the pieces it brought (in id order), the
strength they brought and the steps they have lost; the decision in force and the wake
it was given (BDC).
BattleSide.title: BattleSide

Bias.description: The transform the author's bias applied, in percent [proposed].
Bias.title: Bias

BlocVote.description: A bloc's part of one chamber vote: its members voting and the yeas among them.
BlocVote.title: BlocVote

BodyField.description: One structured line of a document: what the author claims, never the truth.
BodyField.title: BodyField

Call.description: An attack that calls on a defence clause: war on ``against`` is due by ``due``.
Call.title: Call

Capture.description:
A territory's capture count and capital mark. Engine only.

``by`` and ``since``: the polity whose land pieces have stood there unopposed, and the
first day they did; None while nobody counts. ``marked``: the tick of the wake in which
a capital's territory was marked as falling, and ``marked_on`` its day; None unmarked.
Capture.title: Capture

CardPath.description: Which ladder the office stands on (CMD). Read with the ``command`` rule on.
CardPath.title: CardPath

ChannelKind.description: How words travel. Each trades speed against exposure (direction, channels table).
ChannelKind.title: ChannelKind

Character.description:
A real person from the chosen moment that a player may claim (spec §5 step 3).

Judged by agency in history, not fame. Where the record names no one, the
character is a composite: named, built from what people in that role did,
and labelled as such in the brief.
Character.title: Character

CharacterSide.description: Where a roster character stands in one contest. Public, like the roster.
CharacterSide.title: CharacterSide

ClauseType.description: The clauses the rules can check (AGR rule 2), and the one they cannot.
ClauseType.title: ClauseType

Commitment.description: A treaty, contract or deal. Promises in chat are not Commitments.
Commitment.title: Commitment

Conference.title: Conference

ConferenceText.description:
What a conference votes on: its wording, its clauses, the topics its words touch
(by key, worked out when it is called) and whether only a unanimous vote passes it.
ConferenceText.title: ConferenceText

Conferences.description:
Conferences and their sealed votes (CNF). A view holds the conferences its nation
is invited to and every public one, from the day each opens, and its own votes only.
Conferences.title: Conferences

Conflict.description: Something the person is set against, as the world file declares it.
Conflict.title: Conflict

Contact.description: A person in the inner circle, and how the words travel.
Contact.title: Contact

Contest.description:
A pressure that keeps the world moving (spec §5.3).

A rivalry's track runs -100..100, positive favouring ``sides[0]``. A trial's
runs 0..100, 100 = passed. ``momentum`` moves the track every turn whether or
not anyone acts. ``countdown_days`` is in-world days to the deciding point.
Contest.title: Contest

ContestMove.description:
One move a contest names (CON). It lands once: ``landed`` from the day it did.

``region`` (a region key, its subregions included) for a battle; ``area`` for a
holder; ``quantity`` for a flag; for a line, exactly one of ``quantity``, ``nation``
alone (its war-economy figure) or ``nation`` with ``group`` (the group's support),
crossed upward to at or above ``line``, or with ``falling`` downward to below it;
``between`` (two or more nations) for an agreement.
ContestMove.title: ContestMove

ContestWon.description: A contest has been decided for ``side`` (CON).
ContestWon.title: ContestWon

Contingency.description: A force's standing order for a battle, set through the engagement effect (BDC).
Contingency.title: Contingency

ContingencyKind.description: What a force does in a battle with no decision from its seat (BDC).
ContingencyKind.title: ContingencyKind

Deal.description: Offer a deal, or accept one.
Deal.title: Deal

Decider.description:
Who can allow a held order: a person, or a nation's chamber or chambers, with the
head of that nation's government, to whom an ask goes (ASK).
Decider.title: Decider

Decision.description: A side's decision for its battle (BDC). Reinforce is a move order, not stored.
Decision.title: Decision

Disclosure.description: Reveal a fact to the public, or conceal it.
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

Document.description: A document as ``State`` holds it: both halves.
Document.title: Document

DocumentTruth.description: Engine only. Never in a ``View``, a snapshot or a prompt.
DocumentTruth.title: DocumentTruth

DocumentView.description: The page a seat reads. Visible once in scope and ``arrives`` has come.
DocumentView.title: DocumentView

Economy.description: The war economy's truth. A seat sees its own nation's part only.
Economy.title: Economy

Expect.description:
One move the seat's staff expect an option to make. Staff talk, not a forecast:
no rule reads it, and filing the option is the same with or without it.
Expect.title: Expect

ExpectOn.description: What an expected move points at. Each is something the seat's view holds.
ExpectOn.title: ExpectOn

Exposure.description: Whether the seat may see the fact a leaf of its aim reads (AIM rule 5).
Exposure.title: Exposure

Fact.description: A structured truth with an ACL. Never prose.
Fact.title: Fact

Feed.description: A source of documents on a cadence (pillar 3). Whose desk it reaches is on the cards.
Feed.title: Feed

Fidelity.description: How an executor carried out a command (spec §8.2).
Fidelity.title: Fidelity

Forecast.description:
What the staff expected a picked suggestion to move and what they thought it
risked, kept with the order it filed (FCS). Private to the issuer, as the order is.
No rule reads it: an order files and lands the same with or without it.
Forecast.title: Forecast

Goal.description:
One player seat's secret goal. Private to its owner (decision 37).

A goal made from a card's aim (AIM) is keyed to the person whose aim it is
(``person``, ``source``, ``aim``): it is reached through the seat holding that
person at the time, has no objective clock, and ``seat_id`` names the seat it was
made for. A legacy goal has none of the three and keeps its seat and clock.
Goal.title: Goal

GoalSource.description: Where a goal made from an aim comes from (AIM).
GoalSource.title: GoalSource

Group.description: A group at home as the world declares it. True: a view holds its own nation's.
Group.title: Group

GroupNudge.description:
Writing that moves a nation's group at home by ``change`` points (FWG). Only the
estimator returns it, or a theme the world lists: a seat never orders one. The issuer's
own nation's group, or another nation's that the world marks as hearing abroad.
GroupNudge.title: GroupNudge

Groups.description: Groups' truth. A seat sees its own nation's part only.
Groups.title: Groups

Happening.description: The fixed list of happenings a group may be moved by (rule 3).
Happening.title: Happening

HeldChoice.description:
What the holder of a step on another seat's order chose there. Kept for the
holder alone until the step's held due day, when the runner takes the step with it
in the card's place.
HeldChoice.title: HeldChoice

HeldOrder.description:
An order a lock holds: a form order as drafted, or a written order's asks, with
the row that holds it (none for a derived decider), its decider, and the reason its
seat was told. No clock ends it.
HeldOrder.title: HeldOrder

Holding.description:
A territory that has changed hands: its holder now, the one it was taken from, and
the day it was taken. Public.
Holding.title: Holding

HoldsArea.description: A territory's holder now is ``holder`` (THL). Public.
HoldsArea.title: HoldsArea

IncomeAt.description: A nation's war-economy figure (YLD), 0 to 100, against a line. Public.
IncomeAt.title: IncomeAt

Informant.description:
The person who reports one source for a nation, the channel, and the source's rank
(its place in the world's list, from 1, the first highest). Contact no one is named
for reports with rank 0, above every listed source.
Informant.title: Informant

IntelOrder.description:
The intelligence orders an existing effect kind carries (IOR). A patrol is the
patrol posture and a concealment the engagement's ``concealed``; neither is here.
IntelOrder.title: IntelOrder

Intelligence.description: A nation's sources as declared at the start.
Intelligence.title: Intelligence

Kinds.description: The world's piece kinds and resources, by key, in the world file's order.
Kinds.title: Kinds

LawNotInForce.description: Holds while no passed law carrying ``clause`` is in force for the issuer's nation.
LawNotInForce.title: LawNotInForce

Leg.description: One move the record says a feature made.
Leg.title: Leg

Lever.description: Something the person can set moving. Names a pipeline and a resolver, never a verb.
Lever.title: Lever

LiftPriority.description: The production priority's form and the choice of it that grows a lift pool (PRL).
LiftPriority.title: LiftPriority

Link.description:
Two areas that border, ``a`` before ``b``; ``crossing`` names a link across
water or a strait where they share no border.
Link.title: Link

LockRow.description:
One row of the world's ``locks``: which order, under which condition, needs
which decision, from whom.
LockRow.title: LockRow

MandateTemplate.description:
A mandate before it is issued: code fills it in when its trigger fires, one
mandate per seat embodying a person in ``to`` (spec §8.5). Engine only.
MandateTemplate.title: MandateTemplate

MoveFigure.description:
A figure no resolver computes, moved by a percent of its value. Only the
estimator returns it: a seat never orders one.
MoveFigure.title: MoveFigure

MoveForce.description: Move a force, posture it, or both.
MoveForce.title: MoveForce

MoveKind.description: What moves a contest (CON): each a step toward one of its sides.
MoveKind.title: MoveKind

NationVote.description: One invited nation's counted vote at the tally.
NationVote.title: NationVote

NewsEvent.description:
A public event, as structured public facts only. Never prose. One per event;
each seat's press later words it in its own outlet's voice.
NewsEvent.title: NewsEvent

OrderMatch.description:
Which order a row holds: a form with some of its parameter values, or an effect
kind with a zone or a force.
OrderMatch.title: OrderMatch

Ordered.description:
A seat embodying ``person`` issued a routed order with a part of this effect
kind (given, or estimated) whose effects have landed. Never met while no human
holds ``person``: a mandate is the seat's own work (engine v2, spec §8.5).
Ordered.title: Ordered

Outlet.description: A seat's newspaper: the voice its press is written in.
Outlet.title: Outlet

ParamSpec.description: One typed parameter of a lever. An order's params and every amendment must fit it.
ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec

PartRef.description: One part of one routed order: what a pipeline order carries (wave B).
PartRef.title: PartRef

Persona.description: The player-designed face of their agent. Narrative only; no mechanics.
Persona.title: Persona

Phase.description: Where a campaign is in its life (Layer 10). Ticks run only in ``PLAY``.
Phase.title: Phase

Picture.description:
A nation's reports: the delivered one per enemy piece, by key, and those made but
not yet arrived.
Picture.title: Picture

PieceKind.description: One kind of piece the world names.
PieceKind.title: PieceKind

Pools.description: A nation's pools, filled on the first of each month.
Pools.title: Pools

Port.description:
A place where a territory meets a sea zone: a sea piece declared there stands in
the zone, and a land piece embarks or lands there on a lift.
Port.title: Port

PostureNotSet.description:
Holds while no superior of the issuer has set the named posture for the zone.

Two namings, at least one given. The written path: the latest engagement a superior
landed whose zone names ``zone`` carries ``rule``. The form path: the latest enacted
order of ``form`` a superior issued whose parameters carry ``where`` (the zone, as the
form names it) also carries ``posture``.
PostureNotSet.title: PostureNotSet

Production.description:
What the production rules read from the world (PRL). Absent from a board compiled
before it: such a stored game keeps the rules' own names.
Production.title: Production

Proposal.description:
One seat's writing proposing to move a group (rule 2). Engine only: it carries a
hash of the text, never the text, and no filing time.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposeMeasure.description: A bill, treaty or declaration, as a set of clauses.
ProposeMeasure.title: ProposeMeasure

Reach.description:
What reach is derived from (spec §8.1). Whether a meeting is taken is computed
in code from rank, disposition and standing; nothing here is a whitelist.
Reach.title: Reach

RegardAt.description:
How ``a`` and ``b`` regard each other (a relationship's disposition, -5 to 5)
against a line; 0 when they have no relationship yet.
RegardAt.title: RegardAt

Report.description: What a nation believes about one enemy piece, from one source on one day.
Report.title: Report

Restart.description: A moved part of a yield that pays nothing before ``on`` (RSD).
Restart.title: Restart

Risks.description: How much the staff think an option risks, each from 0 (none) to 3. No rule reads it.
Risks.title: Risks

Role.description: What a resource is for. Several resources may share a role; a role may have none.
Role.title: Role

RoutedOrder.description: A committed order, split into routed parts (spec §8.2).
RoutedOrder.title: RoutedOrder

RoutedPart.description: The whole part. ``estimated`` never leaves the engine.
RoutedPart.title: RoutedPart

Rule.description:
A rule of the territory game a world switches on by name. A stored game, and a
world that names none, has none on; every such rule checks its name before it acts.
Rule.title: Rule

ScheduledEvent.description:
Something due to happen. Play events fire at a tick; history events fire on
an in-world date if their condition still holds, and are skipped otherwise.
ScheduledEvent.title: ScheduledEvent

Seat.description:
Anything that holds a view of the world (spec §6, §7, §10).

Humans, AI factions, press outlets and NPCs are all Seats, because they
all need ``project(state, seat_id)``. Only ``PLAYER`` seats hold slots
and an agent persona.
Seat.title: Seat

SeatCard.description:
The whole card. The policy fields below are how code runs an unclaimed person;
they never leave the engine.
SeatCard.title: SeatCard

ShiftDisposition.description: How ``of`` regards ``toward``. Feeds resolvers; never sets a quantity.
ShiftDisposition.title: ShiftDisposition

Sight.description: A document line's claim about a feature: what it is, whose, and where.
Sight.title: Sight

SightRef.description: The truth behind one sighting line.
SightRef.title: SightRef

Spent.description: Writing points a group's batch used on a day, toward the week cap.
Spent.title: Spent

Stance.description: Worst first, so the order of the members is the order of the stances.
Stance.title: Stance

Standing.description: One person's stance toward one seat, from the day it took hold.
Standing.title: Standing

StepOutcome.description: What the person at one step did with the order.
StepOutcome.title: StepOutcome

SupportAt.description: A group's support at home (GRP), 0 to 100, against a line.
SupportAt.title: SupportAt

Tally.description: A conference's result, on the day it was tallied.
Tally.title: Tally

Territory.description: A land area. Its ``area`` is the location entity standing for it.
Territory.title: Territory

Theme.description:
A theme a nation's writing may name, and the points it moves each of that nation's
groups by, signed (FWG rule 3).
Theme.title: Theme

Topic.description:
A matter people want or hold to, named by the world file. An order touches it
by its lever, the kind of a typed effect it carries, or one of its own words.
Engine only.
Topic.title: Topic

TradeLine.description: A trade line: ``amount`` of ``resource`` a month from ``exporter`` to ``importer``.
TradeLine.title: TradeLine

Trigger.description: When a mandate template issues (spec §8.5). Code reads it; no model does.
Trigger.title: Trigger

TruthRef.description: One truth a document was built from, and its value when issued.
TruthRef.title: TruthRef

Verb.description: Closed list. Adding one is a schema change with a migration note.
Verb.title: Verb

Wake.description: The table's shared wake (spec §4). Public: who has committed, never what.
Wake.title: Wake

WarNeed.description:
What one choice of a form needs: its issuer's nation at war with ``nation``, a
polity's world key (WRL). A seat whose nation is not is told "<its nation> is not at war
with <nation>, " and then ``refusal``.
WarNeed.title: WarNeed

WorldMap.description: The board: everything about the map but its shapes.
WorldMap.title: WorldMap

revisionist__core__realism__card__Domain.description: One field the office commands outright (spec §8.1).
revisionist__core__realism__card__Domain.title: Domain

revisionist__core__realism__effect__Clau.description: One clause of a measure. The votes resolver scores each bloc against each.
revisionist__core__realism__effect__Clau.title: Clause

revisionist__core__realism__kinds__Domai.description:
Where a piece moves: over land, over sea, through the air, or as an envoy, who
goes anywhere and fights nobody.
revisionist__core__realism__kinds__Domai.title: Domain

state.description: The full truth. Only the referee and the resolver ever hold one.
state.title: State

ActOf.description:
``person`` did their historical act. Met when no human plays them (history
follows the record); else only when an order that human filed has got there.
ActOf.title: ActOf

Agreement.description: An agreement in force: every named nation accepted the same version.
Agreement.title: Agreement

AgreementClause.description:
One clause of an agreement (AGR rule 1): the party it binds, what it binds them to,
and its date, or None for a standing clause.
AgreementClause.title: AgreementClause

AgreementInForce.description:
An agreement is in force among nations that include every one ``between``
names, none of its clauses broken (AGR).
AgreementInForce.title: AgreementInForce

AgreementOffer.description: An offer of an agreement, as its parties know it.
AgreementOffer.title: AgreementOffer

Agreements.description:
Offers and agreements (AGR). A view holds those its nation is a party to, and
every published agreement.
Agreements.title: Agreements

AidFinding.description:
An aid finding as the board holds it (PRL): the form, the figure it draws on, and
each recipient's share figure and eligibility flag, by polity.
AidFinding.title: AidFinding

Allocate.description: Money or materiel to a recipient.
Allocate.title: Allocate

Ask.description:
One part of an order before it is routed: what the seat wants, in short words,
and the typed effect where the reader found one.
Ask.title: Ask

Asked.description:
A held order asked for, once, by its own seat (ASK): who asked, the person the ask
went to and the seat that holds that person, if any, and the order's plain words. It
decides nothing and opens nothing. The person asked learns only this.
Asked.title: Asked

AtWar.description: Nations ``a`` and ``b`` are at war (``war`` true) or not (false). Public.
AtWar.title: AtWar

Ballot.description: A seat's sealed vote, and the wake it was sealed in.
Ballot.title: Ballot

Base.description: A site a side's pieces work from, for the domains it names (``base`` in the world).
Base.title: Base

BlocVote.description: A bloc's part of one chamber vote: its members voting and the yeas among them.
BlocVote.title: BlocVote

BodyField.description: One structured line of a document: what the author claims, never the truth.
BodyField.title: BodyField

Call.description: An attack that calls on a defence clause: war on ``against`` is due by ``due``.
Call.title: Call

CardFace.description: What anyone knows of the office: who holds it, its powers and its channels.
CardFace.title: CardFace

CardPath.description: Which ladder the office stands on (CMD). Read with the ``command`` rule on.
CardPath.title: CardPath

ChannelKind.description: How words travel. Each trades speed against exposure (direction, channels table).
ChannelKind.title: ChannelKind

Character.description:
A real person from the chosen moment that a player may claim (spec §5 step 3).

Judged by agency in history, not fame. Where the record names no one, the
character is a composite: named, built from what people in that role did,
and labelled as such in the brief.
Character.title: Character

CharacterSide.description: Where a roster character stands in one contest. Public, like the roster.
CharacterSide.title: CharacterSide

ClauseType.description: The clauses the rules can check (AGR rule 2), and the one they cannot.
ClauseType.title: ClauseType

Commitment.description: A treaty, contract or deal. Promises in chat are not Commitments.
Commitment.title: Commitment

Conference.title: Conference

ConferenceText.description:
What a conference votes on: its wording, its clauses, the topics its words touch
(by key, worked out when it is called) and whether only a unanimous vote passes it.
ConferenceText.title: ConferenceText

Conferences.description:
Conferences and their sealed votes (CNF). A view holds the conferences its nation
is invited to and every public one, from the day each opens, and its own votes only.
Conferences.title: Conferences

Contact.description: A person in the inner circle, and how the words travel.
Contact.title: Contact

Contest.description:
A pressure that keeps the world moving (spec §5.3).

A rivalry's track runs -100..100, positive favouring ``sides[0]``. A trial's
runs 0..100, 100 = passed. ``momentum`` moves the track every turn whether or
not anyone acts. ``countdown_days`` is in-world days to the deciding point.
Contest.title: Contest

ContestMove.description:
One move a contest names (CON). It lands once: ``landed`` from the day it did.

``region`` (a region key, its subregions included) for a battle; ``area`` for a
holder; ``quantity`` for a flag; for a line, exactly one of ``quantity``, ``nation``
alone (its war-economy figure) or ``nation`` with ``group`` (the group's support),
crossed upward to at or above ``line``, or with ``falling`` downward to below it;
``between`` (two or more nations) for an agreement.
ContestMove.title: ContestMove

ContestWon.description: A contest has been decided for ``side`` (CON).
ContestWon.title: ContestWon

Contingency.description: A force's standing order for a battle, set through the engagement effect (BDC).
Contingency.title: Contingency

ContingencyKind.description: What a force does in a battle with no decision from its seat (BDC).
ContingencyKind.title: ContingencyKind

Deal.description: Offer a deal, or accept one.
Deal.title: Deal

Decider.description:
Who can allow a held order: a person, or a nation's chamber or chambers, with the
head of that nation's government, to whom an ask goes (ASK).
Decider.title: Decider

Desk.description: The face plus what the person works with. Shown only to the person's own seat.
Desk.title: Desk

Disclosure.description: Reveal a fact to the public, or conceal it.
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

DocumentView.description: The page a seat reads. Visible once in scope and ``arrives`` has come.
DocumentView.title: DocumentView

Economy.description: The war economy's truth. A seat sees its own nation's part only.
Economy.title: Economy

Expect.description:
One move the seat's staff expect an option to make. Staff talk, not a forecast:
no rule reads it, and filing the option is the same with or without it.
Expect.title: Expect

ExpectOn.description: What an expected move points at. Each is something the seat's view holds.
ExpectOn.title: ExpectOn

Fact.description: A structured truth with an ACL. Never prose.
Fact.title: Fact

Fidelity.description: How an executor carried out a command (spec §8.2).
Fidelity.title: Fidelity

Forecast.description:
What the staff expected a picked suggestion to move and what they thought it
risked, kept with the order it filed (FCS). Private to the issuer, as the order is.
No rule reads it: an order files and lands the same with or without it.
Forecast.title: Forecast

Goal.description:
One player seat's secret goal. Private to its owner (decision 37).

A goal made from a card's aim (AIM) is keyed to the person whose aim it is
(``person``, ``source``, ``aim``): it is reached through the seat holding that
person at the time, has no objective clock, and ``seat_id`` names the seat it was
made for. A legacy goal has none of the three and keeps its seat and clock.
Goal.title: Goal

GoalSource.description: Where a goal made from an aim comes from (AIM).
GoalSource.title: GoalSource

Group.description: A group at home as the world declares it. True: a view holds its own nation's.
Group.title: Group

Groups.description: Groups' truth. A seat sees its own nation's part only.
Groups.title: Groups

Happening.description: The fixed list of happenings a group may be moved by (rule 3).
Happening.title: Happening

HeldChoice.description:
What the holder of a step on another seat's order chose there. Kept for the
holder alone until the step's held due day, when the runner takes the step with it
in the card's place.
HeldChoice.title: HeldChoice

HeldOrder.description:
An order a lock holds: a form order as drafted, or a written order's asks, with
the row that holds it (none for a derived decider), its decider, and the reason its
seat was told. No clock ends it.
HeldOrder.title: HeldOrder

Holding.description:
A territory that has changed hands: its holder now, the one it was taken from, and
the day it was taken. Public.
Holding.title: Holding

HoldsArea.description: A territory's holder now is ``holder`` (THL). Public.
HoldsArea.title: HoldsArea

IncomeAt.description: A nation's war-economy figure (YLD), 0 to 100, against a line. Public.
IncomeAt.title: IncomeAt

IntelOrder.description:
The intelligence orders an existing effect kind carries (IOR). A patrol is the
patrol posture and a concealment the engagement's ``concealed``; neither is here.
IntelOrder.title: IntelOrder

Kinds.description: The world's piece kinds and resources, by key, in the world file's order.
Kinds.title: Kinds

LawNotInForce.description: Holds while no passed law carrying ``clause`` is in force for the issuer's nation.
LawNotInForce.title: LawNotInForce

Lever.description: Something the person can set moving. Names a pipeline and a resolver, never a verb.
Lever.title: Lever

LiftPriority.description: The production priority's form and the choice of it that grows a lift pool (PRL).
LiftPriority.title: LiftPriority

Link.description:
Two areas that border, ``a`` before ``b``; ``crossing`` names a link across
water or a strait where they share no border.
Link.title: Link

LockRow.description:
One row of the world's ``locks``: which order, under which condition, needs
which decision, from whom.
LockRow.title: LockRow

MoveFigure.description:
A figure no resolver computes, moved by a percent of its value. Only the
estimator returns it: a seat never orders one.
MoveFigure.title: MoveFigure

MoveForce.description: Move a force, posture it, or both.
MoveForce.title: MoveForce

MoveKind.description: What moves a contest (CON): each a step toward one of its sides.
MoveKind.title: MoveKind

NationVote.description: One invited nation's counted vote at the tally.
NationVote.title: NationVote

OrderMatch.description:
Which order a row holds: a form with some of its parameter values, or an effect
kind with a zone or a force.
OrderMatch.title: OrderMatch

Ordered.description:
A seat embodying ``person`` issued a routed order with a part of this effect
kind (given, or estimated) whose effects have landed. Never met while no human
holds ``person``: a mandate is the seat's own work (engine v2, spec §8.5).
Ordered.title: Ordered

ParamSpec.description: One typed parameter of a lever. An order's params and every amendment must fit it.
ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec

PartRef.description: One part of one routed order: what a pipeline order carries (wave B).
PartRef.title: PartRef

PartView.description: One part of a routed order, as its issuer knows it.
PartView.title: PartView

Persona.description: The player-designed face of their agent. Narrative only; no mechanics.
Persona.title: Persona

Phase.description: Where a campaign is in its life (Layer 10). Ticks run only in ``PLAY``.
Phase.title: Phase

PieceKind.description: One kind of piece the world names.
PieceKind.title: PieceKind

Pools.description: A nation's pools, filled on the first of each month.
Pools.title: Pools

Port.description:
A place where a territory meets a sea zone: a sea piece declared there stands in
the zone, and a land piece embarks or lands there on a lift.
Port.title: Port

PostureNotSet.description:
Holds while no superior of the issuer has set the named posture for the zone.

Two namings, at least one given. The written path: the latest engagement a superior
landed whose zone names ``zone`` carries ``rule``. The form path: the latest enacted
order of ``form`` a superior issued whose parameters carry ``where`` (the zone, as the
form names it) also carries ``posture``.
PostureNotSet.title: PostureNotSet

Production.description:
What the production rules read from the world (PRL). Absent from a board compiled
before it: such a stored game keeps the rules' own names.
Production.title: Production

Proposal.description:
One seat's writing proposing to move a group (rule 2). Engine only: it carries a
hash of the text, never the text, and no filing time.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposeMeasure.description: A bill, treaty or declaration, as a set of clauses.
ProposeMeasure.title: ProposeMeasure

Reach.description:
What reach is derived from (spec §8.1). Whether a meeting is taken is computed
in code from rank, disposition and standing; nothing here is a whitelist.
Reach.title: Reach

RegardAt.description:
How ``a`` and ``b`` regard each other (a relationship's disposition, -5 to 5)
against a line; 0 when they have no relationship yet.
RegardAt.title: RegardAt

Report.description: What a nation believes about one enemy piece, from one source on one day.
Report.title: Report

Restart.description: A moved part of a yield that pays nothing before ``on`` (RSD).
Restart.title: Restart

Risks.description: How much the staff think an option risks, each from 0 (none) to 3. No rule reads it.
Risks.title: Risks

Role.description: What a resource is for. Several resources may share a role; a role may have none.
Role.title: Role

RoutedOrderView.description: An engine-v2 order as its issuer knows it.
RoutedOrderView.title: RoutedOrderView

ScheduledEvent.description:
Something due to happen. Play events fire at a tick; history events fire on
an in-world date if their condition still holds, and are skipped otherwise.
ScheduledEvent.title: ScheduledEvent

Seat.description:
Anything that holds a view of the world (spec §6, §7, §10).

Humans, AI factions, press outlets and NPCs are all Seats, because they
all need ``project(state, seat_id)``. Only ``PLAYER`` seats hold slots
and an agent persona.
Seat.title: Seat

SeatFace.description:
What any seat may know about another: who it is, never how it is run.

spec §17: whether a seat is human or AI, its agent, its persona, its
status (blinded, fallen) and its deputy are never shown to other seats.
SeatFace.title: SeatFace

ShiftDisposition.description: How ``of`` regards ``toward``. Feeds resolvers; never sets a quantity.
ShiftDisposition.title: ShiftDisposition

Sight.description: A document line's claim about a feature: what it is, whose, and where.
Sight.title: Sight

Spent.description: Writing points a group's batch used on a day, toward the week cap.
Spent.title: Spent

StepOutcome.description: What the person at one step did with the order.
StepOutcome.title: StepOutcome

SupportAt.description: A group's support at home (GRP), 0 to 100, against a line.
SupportAt.title: SupportAt

Tally.description: A conference's result, on the day it was tallied.
Tally.title: Tally

Territory.description: A land area. Its ``area`` is the location entity standing for it.
Territory.title: Territory

Theme.description:
A theme a nation's writing may name, and the points it moves each of that nation's
groups by, signed (FWG rule 3).
Theme.title: Theme

TradeLine.description: A trade line: ``amount`` of ``resource`` a month from ``exporter`` to ``importer``.
TradeLine.title: TradeLine

Verb.description: Closed list. Adding one is a schema change with a migration note.
Verb.title: Verb

Wake.description: The table's shared wake (spec §4). Public: who has committed, never what.
Wake.title: Wake

WarNeed.description:
What one choice of a form needs: its issuer's nation at war with ``nation``, a
polity's world key (WRL). A seat whose nation is not is told "<its nation> is not at war
with <nation>, " and then ``refusal``.
WarNeed.title: WarNeed

WorldMap.description: The board: everything about the map but its shapes.
WorldMap.title: WorldMap

revisionist__core__realism__card__Domain.title: Domain

revisionist__core__realism__effect__Clau.title: Clause

Where a piece moves: over land, over sea, through the air, or as an envoy, who

revisionist__core__realism__kinds__Domai.title: Domain

view.description: One seat's knowledge. The only input to anything that writes prose.
view.title: View
